g.text: Title: 07 - Waveshare Tiny / SPI / kit USB

g.desc: Title: 07 - Waveshare Tiny / SPI / kit USB

g.text: BENCH REVIEW ONLY - NO HUMAN / FABRICATION RELEASE

g.desc: BENCH REVIEW ONLY - NO HUMAN / FABRICATION RELEASE

g.text: USB/BOOT/RESET run over the supplied FPC to the kit adapter.

g.desc: USB/BOOT/RESET run over the supplied FPC to the kit adapter.

g.text: They are NOT on the 18 side socket contacts. Never substitute a

g.desc: They are NOT on the 18 side socket contacts. Never substitute a

g.text: bare ESP32-S3-MINI-1 or ESP32-S3-Zero into this footprint.

g.desc: bare ESP32-S3-MINI-1 or ESP32-S3-Zero into this footprint.

g.text: CS=GPIO2, MOSI=GPIO1; bottom five pads NOT used.

g.desc: CS=GPIO2, MOSI=GPIO1; bottom five pads NOT used.

g.text: GPIO38 RGB OFF. No underside pads soldered.

g.desc: GPIO38 RGB OFF. No underside pads soldered.

g.text: Strapping pins and internal PSRAM signals have no carrier load.

g.desc: Strapping pins and internal PSRAM signals have no carrier load.

g.text: Use the matching Waveshare adapter + supplied FPC; do not improvise cable orientation.

g.desc: Use the matching Waveshare adapter + supplied FPC; do not improvise cable orientation.

g.text: Adapter contains USB-C, two CC 5.1k resistors, BOOT/RESET and power LED.

g.desc: Adapter contains USB-C, two CC 5.1k resistors, BOOT/RESET and power LED.

g.text: Tiny contains ME6217 regulator, USB power-blocking diode,22R USB resistors,BOOT/EN pullups.

g.desc: Tiny contains ME6217 regulator, USB power-blocking diode,22R USB resistors,BOOT/EN pullups.

g.text: USB data does not traverse the carrier. Adapter schematic shows no dedicated USB ESD array.

g.desc: USB data does not traverse the carrier. Adapter schematic shows no dedicated USB ESD array.

g.text: USB path and input inrush remain vendor-board dependent; hot plugging only at USB-C.

g.desc: USB path and input inrush remain vendor-board dependent; hot plugging only at USB-C.

g.text: Disconnect power before changing the FPC. Secure adapter/FPC so cable pull cannot stress lands.

g.desc: Disconnect power before changing the FPC. Secure adapter/FPC so cable pull cannot stress lands.

g.text: DMA/ring buffer + binary framing + sequence/overflow counters; sustained capture test required.

g.desc: DMA/ring buffer + binary framing + sequence/overflow counters; sustained capture test required.

g.text: RF and RGB OFF during initial EMG acquisition. PC runs ML. This carrier contains no firmware.

g.desc: RF and RGB OFF during initial EMG acquisition. PC runs ML. This carrier contains no firmware.

g.text: OFF-BOARD KIT ADAPTER (PREASSEMBLED; INCLUDED IN ACCESSORY BOM)

g.desc: OFF-BOARD KIT ADAPTER (PREASSEMBLED; INCLUDED IN ACCESSORY BOM)
